entities.summary: Sanzen-in (三千院) is a Tendai school monzeki temple in Ōhara, Kyoto, Japan. The Heian period triad of Amida Nyorai flanked by attendants is a National Treasure. Sanzen-in Temple is a Buddhist temple in Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
